exposure: Mode of delivery (Trial of Labour After Caesarean (TOLAC) vs Elective Repeat Caesarean Section (ERCS))
outcome: Successful Vaginal Birth After Caesarean (VBAC) rate
cohort: Pregnant women with a previous caesarean delivery between 2015 and 2019.
finding: There were no significant differences between the successful VBAC group and the failure group in regard to nationality, marital status, level of education, maternal age, gestational age at delivery and birth weight.
